'''Scelepas''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was located in the [[Tanta Aurek system/Legends|Tanta Aurek system]], in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. Between [[3701 BBY]] and [[3699 BBY]] the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] was charted through the planet as part of the [[Seswenna Expansion]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Before or during the [[Republic Dark Age]], Scelepas was a motley trade world dominated by [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] from the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cmaoli Di/Legends|Cmaoli Di]]. However, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Charge Matrica|Second ''Charge Matrica'']], the world had descended into grinding poverty.
